brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested a released prisoner from Tulkarm, Shehab Wire reported. The detainee had previously been held in Israeli custody before his liberation. The arrest marks another instance of Israeli forces apprehending individuals with prior detention records.

The circumstances surrounding the arrest remain unclear. No information has been disclosed regarding the prisoner's identity, the timing of his initial release, or the reasons for his re-arrest. Israeli military officials have not issued statements about the operation.
